description: The graph illustrates the performance of various expert-specialized fine-tuning methods across different sample token counts, with the y-axis representing the "Score of Two for shared Experts" and the x-axis showing the "Sample Token Count" on a logarithmic scale ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$. The plot includes seven distinct lines, each corresponding to a different category as indicated by the legend: Intent (red), Summary (blue), Law (yellow), Translation (purple), Code (gray), and Math (green). The red line (Intent) starts at approximately 4.2 and rises steadily, peaking around $2^{15}$ before leveling off near 6.0. The blue line (Summary) begins at about 2.0 and sharply increases to around 5.8 by $2^{11}$, then continues to rise more gradually. The yellow line (Law) starts at 3.8 and climbs to about 5.9 by $2^{15}$. The purple line (Translation) begins at 5.3 and increases to 6.0 by $2^{14}$. The gray line (Code) starts at 2.0 and shows a steep rise to 6.0 by $2^{15}$. The green line (Math) begins at 3.9 and rises to 6.0 by $2^{15}$. All lines converge toward the upper right, indicating improved performance with increasing token counts.
